title: A Message from Ali
text:
Hi Anna, how are you? I am fine, thanks. I am writing from Istanbul because I have a new job here. The job is good, but it is very busy.

Can you visit me next month? My flat has a big window and a small balcony. We can have dinner on the balcony. Write back soon! Love, Ali.

questions.text: What does Ali ask Anna to do?
How does Ali feel about his new job?
options: He hates it and wants to leave
He likes it, but it is busy
He does not have a job
He is bored because there is nothing to do

questions.text: What is the most likely relationship between Ali and Anna?

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
a platform outside a building, connected to a room
to go to see a person or place for a short time
a set of rooms for living in, on one floor of a building

paragraph_translations: Merhaba Anna, nasılsın? İyiyim, teşekkürler. Yeni bir işim olduğu için buradan İstanbul'dan yazıyorum. İş iyi, ama çok meşgul.
Gelecek ay beni ziyaret edebilir misin? Dairemin büyük bir penceresi ve küçük bir balkonu var. Balkonda birlikte akşam yemeği yiyebiliriz. Yakında cevap yaz! Sevgilerle, Ali.
